name: Sterling & Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd
about: Sterling and Wilson Solar Ltd is one of the leading end-to-end solar engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) solutions provider globally and is also engaged in the operation and maintenance (O&M) of solar power projects. The company is backed by strong parentage of the Reliance Industries
keyPoints:
Promoters
The company was earlier a part of the Shapoorji Pallonji Group. In 2022, Reliance Industries acquired a 40% stake in the Company through its subsidiary Reliance New Energy Limited. As of March 2025, Reliance held 32.5% and Shapoorji Pallonji 6.9% stake in the company. [1] [2]
